interface.signature: def orderlyQueue(S: str, K: int) -> str

preconditions.description: K must be between 1 and the length of S inclusive.
All characters in S must be lowercase letters.

postconditions.expression: return_value == min(S[i:] + S[:i] for i in range(len(S)))
postconditions.description: The returned string is the lexicographically smallest string obtainable by rotating the string S.
